I am a SAP Consultant with more than 3 decades of total experience, with 24 (since 2002) years of SAP consulting experience in Supply Chain area. Before SAP Consulting, I worked for 11 (1990 - 2001) years in manufacturing / shop floor, with last assignment as a Plant General Manager for a manufacturing unit, that helps me understand the business process to transform the business into SAP.

Apart from configuration, writing FSPECs, testing, client meeting for UAT sign off, I have extensive experience with conducting workshops, training, developing BPP documents, defect management, project management and coordination across teams for meeting the deliverable timelines.
